page.overview:
Who is Abigail Keating?

When Ursula attended a start of term dance after enrolling in Holliday College her out of date fashions and slang made her stick out and drew the attention of Etta Candy and Diana Prince. Ursula became upset as she realized how out of touch she was, feeling mocked by the attention. Diana offered her a ride home and met Abigail, wandering the halls of her mansion in her wedding dress. Abigail showed Diana a miniature of her long missing fiance John Hunter and Di realized he was familiar, leading to the capture of the famous thief who had long been going by the pseudonym Lon Logix.

Category:Independently Wealthy Category:Wonder Woman Supporting Cast
